summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of the AI Sales CRM Phase 1 rebuild. Wrote 22 pytest tests covering auth, multi-tenant isolation, deals CRUD + stage drag, contacts, at-risk + AI churn explain, AI email draft, AI insights generate/list, team RBAC, and billing. All 22 backend tests pass. Playwright covered login, dashboard KPIs/charts/insights, kanban with 70 deals across 6 columns, at-risk page with Groq explain, contacts, team invite/roles, billing plans. All flows work and Groq (qwen/qwen3.6-27b) returns non-empty AI responses.

minor.issue: Accepts arbitrary deal_id without validating it belongs to the caller's org — send() does not verify deal_id ownership (low impact today since no DB write, but tightens security)
Returned temp_password is only shown once in the API response; no email delivery yet — acceptable for Phase 1 but note there's no way to re-issue it
Two 401 errors are logged in the browser console on initial page load before login (AuthContext calls /auth/me on mount). Expected but noisy — consider silencing on 401.

issues: Only 4 stages render bars (Lead/Contacted/Proposal/Negotiation) — closed_won/closed_lost intentionally hidden from open pipeline chart; visually fine but a legend/tooltip would help.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: login lockout uses ip+email identifier and increments even on valid attempts before the delete — the delete after success clears it correctly, so behavior is right; however, `locked_until` is overwritten on every failed attempt to now+15m even at count=1, which is fine but slightly aggressive. Acceptable.
auth.py: bcrypt hash starts with $2b$ (verified), httpOnly + samesite=none + secure cookies set correctly. CORS uses explicit FRONTEND_URL origin with allow_credentials=True. Playbook-compliant.
dashboard.py: /ai/email/send silently returns sent=false on any exception without incrementing ai_credits — OK for stub.

deals.py: `days_in_stage` is stored but never incremented over time (only reset on stage change). Churn scoring based on it will not evolve — consider a scheduled task or compute-on-read using created_at/updated_at.
routers/team.py: no check preventing an admin from downgrading another admin without owner consent — minor RBAC gap.
billing.py upgrade is intentionally a stub (Phase 2 Stripe) — acceptable per requirements.
seed_data_creation: Seed runs on backend startup (Northwind Sales Co, 4 users, 40 contacts, 70 deals). Tests only add TEST_-prefixed data and clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. UI Layout uses '/' for Dashboard route (not '/dashboard') — use [data-testid=nav-dashboard] to detect post-login. All data-testids present per spec. Groq calls take 2-6s, so wait accordingly. Registration endpoint lowercases emails.
